status.description: What you are handing back. `submitted`: you did the work and committed it. It claims nothing about whether the work is acceptable -- gates and a reviewer run after you, and they decide. `blocked`: you could not proceed within policy and are stopping.

block_reason.description: Why you cannot proceed, specific enough that a human reading only this line knows what to change. Required when status is `blocked`.

title.description: One line naming the thing that is now known.

body.description: Markdown. The constraint, invariant, or gotcha itself, plus enough of why for a reader to know when it stops applying.

for_future_agents.description: Durable knowledge a future agent working in this area would need, written for someone who was not here. Return `[]` if you learned nothing that outlives this task -- that is the common case and is expected. Do not restate the task, narrate what you did, or record anything already true in the repo's docs.
